messages:
Marta: quick RFC follow-up: i'm prototyping a 'soft-degrade' for active/active when cross-region write forwarding fails (capacity/legal flags). idea: accept locally for "prefers-local" tenants but escrow payloads for later reconcile; strict tenants get explicit rejection. asking for sanity checks + rollback plan.

Liam: high-level seems ok. how do we classify tenants at runtime? a header? tenant-level policy?

Marta: tenant.policy from control plane (we already have a consent matrix service). decisions at proxy edge.

Sara: two concerns: ordering/idempotency when we replay; and SGAs: clients might think write succeeded when it's escrowed. need clear response semantics.

Raj: for replay, use per-tenant monotonic write_id + idempotency tokens. escrow queue should be append-only with a tombstone map to dedupe.

Marta: sketch of edge logic:
```
if tenant.residency == "strict":
  return 409 (write-deferred)
elif tenant.residency == "prefers-local":
  accept locally, enqueue->escrow on forward failure
else:
  forward normally
```
Return 202 + header X-Write-Status: escrowed for accepted-but-queued.

Liam: prefer header approach to avoid breaking clients. 202 vs 200 difference matters.

Olivia: legal: escrowed PII crossing borders needs consent. can we encrypt escrow payloads with tenant-specific KMS keys and ensure decryption only in resident region?

Raj: yes. store ciphertext in escrow, keys in resident region HSM. reconciliation workers in resident region decrypt & apply.

Sara: telemetry: track escrow-enqueue-rate, reconcile-latency, reconcile-fail-rate. alert if backlog > 10k or oldest item > 1hr.

OpsBot: canary deploy scheduled: residency-soft-degrade v0.1 -> canary on edge-eu-03 at 4112356900. watch escrow-queue-depth, forward-fail-rate, reconcile-errors.

Marta: rollout plan:
- start with 2 low-risk tenants in eu region for 2 hours
- validate no cross-border store of PII, reconcile median < 5m
- expand percentage if metrics stable
- auto-rollback if backlog grows or reconcile-error-rate > 1%

Liam: rollback mechanism: feature-flag toggle in control-plane that forces fallback to 'reject local-accept' (409) immediately. cheap and safe.

Olivia: add legal-safe toggle to entirely forbid cross-region escrow even encrypted.

Raj: infra note: escrow store = append-only S3 + indexer (kinesis) to feed reconciliation workers. lifecycle retention 7d. pre-warm reconcilers to handle spikes.

Sara: action items: (1) Marta -> PR for control-plane policy + X-Write-Status header; (2) Raj -> prototype escrow queue + idempotency; (3) Liam -> client-compat doc w/ response codes; (4) Olivia -> legal checklist + KMS plan.

Marta: will open issues and a short explainer. thx everyone :thumbsup: 

Liam: test idea: force region partition in chaos rig; verify canary tenants get 202+X-Write-Status: escrowed, strict tenants get 409.

OpsBot: canary summary at 4112357000: escrow enqueue 9/min, avg reconcile 2m10s, no reconcile failures, no legal-flag violations.

Olivia: good signal. keep KMS audit logs for compliance.

Marta: scheduling follow-up sync Tue to decide production thresholds. closing loop :sparkles:
